Promise.title: Three commitments, kept from the first day to the last.

items.title: Verified members
items.text: Every member shows an identity document, meets our team for an interview and declares their marital status. Nobody joins without this verification.

items.title: Real-life meetings
items.text: There is no photo gallery here. You get to know a person through what they write about themselves, then face to face, at an organised evening.

items.title: Guidance until your union
items.text: After a mutual agreement, a couple counsellor accompanies you at your own pace. We stay by your side until the bride price, the wedding or the celebration of your choice.

Journey.title: A clear journey, one step at a time.

steps.title: Registration
steps.text: You create your account with your phone number, then describe yourself sincerely.

steps.title: Verification
steps.text: Identity document, interview with our team and a sworn statement. Your profile is reviewed before it is published.

steps.title: Evening
steps.text: You book an evening. There, you meet each participant of the opposite sex in turn, for seven minutes.

steps.title: Mutual agreement
steps.text: After each conversation, you say whether you would like to see the person again. There is an agreement only if both answer yes.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: For fourteen days, you talk privately, you finally see each other's photos and you meet at a partner venue.

steps.title: Couple space
steps.text: If you both choose to continue, your space opens, with a counsellor to guide you.

steps.title: Union celebrated
steps.text: Bride price, civil, religious or traditional wedding. Your space then becomes a keepsake space.

Journey.noMatch: No mutual agreement this time? Simply book another evening.

Evenings.title: An evening designed for real conversation.
Evenings.intro: We host up to three evenings a week in Cotonou. The atmosphere is calm, the lighting soft, the service attentive. You come to talk, not to be judged on a photo.

steps.label: Welcome
steps.text: Our team greets you and gives you your table number. You confirm your attendance 48 hours beforehand.

steps.label: Conversations
steps.text: Ten women, ten men. The women stay at their table, the men move at each round. Seven minutes per meeting, with a break halfway through.

steps.label: Your choice
steps.text: After each conversation, you scan the table code and answer discreetly. You may change your mind until the end of the evening.

steps.label: The next morning
steps.text: At 8 a.m., you receive your mutual agreements. Nobody ever knows who said no.

Evenings.venue: The venue is chosen for its calm and discretion. Its address is shared with confirmed participants.
Evenings.themes: Some evenings have a theme: age range, faith, professional background.
Evenings.imageAlt: A carefully set table, glasses and lit candles.

Safety.title: You stay in control, at every moment.
Safety.intro: We designed Wanyiyi so that everyone feels confident. Women in particular, who have often asked us for it.

items.title: Every member is verified
items.text: Identity document, interview and declaration of marital status. Documents are kept in a private space, accessible only to the verification team.

items.title: No public photos
items.text: Your photo never appears on the site. It becomes visible only after a mutual agreement, and you may choose to keep it blurred.

items.title: A personal watermark
items.text: Every time a photo is displayed, it carries the name of the person viewing it, with the date and time. Any copy could be traced at once.

items.title: Your contact details stay private
items.text: Phone numbers, links and addresses are blocked in profiles. Numbers are exchanged only if you both decide to.

items.title: Reports handled quickly
items.text: A report button is available on every profile and every conversation. Our team aims to handle each report within 24 hours.

Support.title: A trusted person by your side.
Support.discoveryText: Each mutual agreement opens fourteen days to get to know each other: a private conversation, your photos, a first meeting suggested at a partner venue. You hold at most two discoveries at a time, to give each one the time it deserves.
Support.counselorText: When you both decide to continue, you choose a life and couple counsellor together. They guide you through the important steps: sessions, meeting the families, preparing your union.
Support.consentText: The counsellor never reads your conversation without the consent of you both. Each of you may write to them privately, and each of you may withdraw their access at any time.
Support.quote: Our role is to light the way. The decision is always yours.

Celebration.title: Until the day you say yes.
Celebration.intro: Whether your union takes place at the town hall, the church, the mosque or according to tradition with the bride price, we help you prepare it.

items.title: Bride price and tradition
items.text: Guidance to prepare the meeting of both families, respecting everyone's customs.

items.title: Partner providers
items.text: Caterers, tailors, photographers, reception venues. Reliable names, recommended by our team.

items.title: A shared fund for your loved ones
items.text: Your family and friends can contribute to your union, simply, by Mobile Money.

Celebration.imageAlt: A couple in golden traditional attire share a knowing look.

items.q: Why can't I see members' photos?
items.a: Because we want you to meet a person, not an image. Photos are revealed only after a mutual agreement, and they are protected by a watermark.
You send an identity document, you have an interview with a member of our team and you sign a sworn statement about your marital status. Your profile is approved once these three steps are complete.

items.q: What if nobody appeals to me at an evening?
items.a: Nothing awkward happens. Nobody knows who said no. You can book another evening whenever you wish.

items.q: Can I have several discoveries at the same time?
items.a: Yes, two at most. If you have more mutual agreements, you choose which ones to open. The others wait for seven days.

items.q: Can the counsellor read our messages?
items.a: Only if you both agree. A banner stays visible as long as they have access to the conversation, and either of you may withdraw that access at any time.
By Mobile Money, MTN or Moov. Registration fees and evening bookings are paid directly from your member space.

items.q: Can I leave the platform at any time?
items.a: Yes, without giving a reason. You can also download your data or request the deletion of your account from your settings.

items.q: Can divorced or widowed people join?
items.a: Of course. We simply ask you to declare your situation honestly, like every member.

About.title: An introduction house, not an app.

sections.title: Why Wanyiyi
paragraphs: Many women and men in Cotonou wish to start a family, yet no longer know where to meet a serious partner. Apps multiply photos and conversations that lead nowhere. Introductions through friends are not always enough.
Wanyiyi offers another way: verified members, face-to-face meetings and human guidance, all the way to your union.

sections.title: Our principles
paragraphs: Respect first. Every member commits to courteous and honest behaviour, online and at evenings.
Discretion next. No photo is public, no contact detail is shared without your consent.
Time, finally. We prefer one right meeting to ten hurried ones.

sections.title: Who it is for
paragraphs: For women and men seeking a lasting union: civil, religious or traditional marriage with the bride price. Single, divorced or widowed, everyone is welcome, provided they declare it sincerely.

Rules.title: The rules that protect everyone.
Rules.intro: By becoming a member, you accept these rules. They exist so that every person feels respected and safe.

sections.title: 1. Sincerity
paragraphs: You declare your true marital status and describe yourself honestly. Any false statement leads to exclusion.
You are looking for a lasting relationship. Wanyiyi is not a place for casual affairs.

sections.title: 2. Respect
paragraphs: You remain courteous at all times, at evenings and in conversations. Inappropriate, insistent or hurtful remarks are forbidden.
A negative answer is respected, without questions or insistence.

sections.title: 3. Discretion
paragraphs: You do not publish any phone number, address, link or social media handle in your profile.
You do not copy, photograph or share any photo or message from another member.

sections.title: 4. Evenings
paragraphs: You confirm your attendance no later than 48 hours before the evening. Without confirmation, your place is offered to the waiting list.
You arrive on time and stay until the last round, out of respect for the other participants.

sections.title: 5. Discovery and couple space
paragraphs: You hold at most two discoveries at a time. When you enter a couple space, you commit to exclusivity and you no longer book evenings while the space remains open.
Either person may end a relationship at any time, without giving a reason.

sections.title: 6. Reports and sanctions
paragraphs: If any behaviour makes you uncomfortable, report it. Our team aims to handle each report within 24 hours.
Depending on the severity, sanctions range from a warning to permanent exclusion.

Privacy.title: What we do with your data.
Privacy.intro: Your data is precious. We collect as little as possible and protect it with the greatest care.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: Company name, address and contact of the controller: to be completed.

sections.title: Data collected
paragraphs: Your phone number, your identity, your identity document, your marital status declaration, your profile answers, your photos, your bookings, your votes and your messages.
We never ask for your skin tone, your ethnicity, your exact address or the name of your employer.

sections.title: Why we use it
paragraphs: To verify your identity, organise evenings, compute mutual agreements, enable conversations after an agreement and keep you safe.

sections.title: Who can access it
paragraphs: Your identity document is accessible only to the verification team, and every access is recorded.
Your photos are visible only after a mutual agreement. The counsellor reads your couple conversation only with the consent of you both.
Your income, if you choose to share it, is never visible to other members.

sections.title: Retention periods
paragraphs: After a separation, the conversation is kept for 90 days, accessible only to moderation, then deleted.
After a celebrated union, the conversation becomes read-only and is deleted after 12 months, unless you both ask to keep it.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: At any time, you may download your data, correct it or request the deletion of your account from your settings.
For any question, write to us at the address given in the legal notice.
